component.name: QFileMan
component.summary: Qt file manager with plugin support

description.p: QFileMan is a small Qt-based file manager built with PyQt6. It pairs a sidebar tree view with a configurable file list and exposes a Python plugin system for menu items, navigation hooks, and file filters.

ul.li: Sidebar tree view and file list with list/grid modes
Sort by name, size, date (newest first), or extension
Bookmarks, file info, and quick-navigation built-in plugins
Extensible Python plugin system: MenuProvider, NavigationHook, FileFilter
